title: Play a guided first exchange.
goal: Play one safe first move and observe the coach's reply.
narration_seed: A guided first exchange helps you place a piece near the middle of the board and keep your pieces protected.
hints: Choose a move allowed by the rules that brings a piece into play or helps control the middle of the board.
solution_text: There is no single solution; choose a safe first move and learn from the coach's reply.
success_text: You completed a guided first exchange with the coach.
failure_text: Continue the guided first exchange until the coach has replied.
